title: Shared basis plus Mirror codes for a multi-context KV prefix bank
hypothesis: Across a bank of independent 64-token text-context prefixes, one per-layer rank-128 shared latent basis plus compact rank-4 context-specific residual codes can preserve next-token quality while reducing aggregate serialized prefix-bank bytes versus storing every prefix cache independently.
physical_object: A bank of context-specific 6-layer Pythia KV prefix caches, 8 heads x K/V x 64 dimensions, 64 tokens each
mirror_coordinate: Per-token, per-context, per-layer, per-K/V-role rank-4 coefficients over a shared per-layer residual dictionary
scope_boundary: This is an actual KV-prefix bank compression screen over textual contexts. It does not train continuous Prefix-Tuning parameters and cannot establish Prefix-Tuning adaptation quality; any positive result is limited to context-cache sharing.
controls: FP16 full KV cache per context
shared per-layer rank-128 MLA/PCA basis without residual codes
shared basis plus rank-4 context-specific Mirror residual codes
exact native shared residual dictionary/code control

calibration.pca: centered joint 1024D K/V vectors per layer pooled over 32 calibration contexts; retain rank 128
calibration.residual_dictionary: rank-4 PCA per K/V role and layer pooled over calibration contexts; context-specific token coefficients are m

evaluation.metric: next-token NLL after one query token using the reconstructed context KV prefix

development.selection_metric: NLL, cache reconstruction MSE, actual serialized basis/cache payload bytes at 1/4/8/16 contexts, encode/reconstruct/query wall time

paid_objects: per-context FP16 latent and residual coefficient arrays
all shape, dtype and schema metadata

success_gate: Both dev seeds: Mirror NLL delta <=0.05 nat/token versus FP16 and >=0.02 nat/token better than shared MLA without residual; 16-context aggregate bytes <=0.75x FP16 bank; no exact native-control alias; include actual amortized model-state cost.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte miss or exact native shared-dictionary alias.
boundaries: Bases are fit on train-context caches only; validation contexts choose no hyperparameters beyond this frozen configuration
Prefix is a text-derived KV context cache, not learned continuous Prefix-Tuning state
One query token after each context is scored; no full-sequence perplexity claim
CPU operation proxies only; no fused serving claim
Fresh test split remains sealed after any dev gate miss or native alias
